documents.title: Cancer Risk in Diabetic Patients Treated with Metformin: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
documents.why_tier: pools multiple studies and reports a combined estimate
institutions: National Center for Global Health and Medicine
documents.quote: the risks of cancer among metformin users were significantly lower than those among non-metformin users: the pooled RRs (95% confidence interval) were 0.66 (0.49-0.88) for cancer mortality, 0.67 (0.53-0.85) for all-cancer incidence, 0.68 (0.53-0.88) for colorectal cancer (n = 6), 0.20 (0.07-0.59) for hepatocellular cancer (n = 4), 0.67 (0.45-0.99) for lung cancer (n = 3).
documents.verification_scope: Quotation verified, not independent validation of the interpretation.
documents.why: Shows lower cancer risk in metformin‑treated diabetics.

source_fit.method: separate model review; not independent fact-check
source_fit.reason: matches claim (diabetic patients, metformin vs non, cancer risk)
